image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a folded paper menu. The menu is divided into two visible panels (left and right) with a central fold. The text is heavily distorted, appearing as gibberish or 'alien' script rather than legible English or any standard language. The layout mimics a standard restaurant menu with headings and list items, but the content is nonsensical. The color palette is muted, with greenish and brownish tones on a textured paper background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The primary function of a menu is to convey information via text. The text here is completely illegible, consisting of hallucinated characters, warped letters, and non-existent words. This is a catastrophic failure for this class.

The edges of the text characters bleed into the paper texture, lacking the sharp contrast of ink on paper. The paper grain itself appears somewhat smeared and inconsistent, particularly near the fold.
The lines of text on the right panel warp and curve unnaturally, not following the physical plane of the paper accurately. Some characters appear to float above or sink into the page inconsistently.
